CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (SporeMind.cs:12) == `exhausts = True`, and crucially NOT Unplayable -- Spore Mind is a PLAYABLE curse whose whole function is that you can pay 1 energy to make it go away. The sim correctly leaves `is_playable` at True.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Curse, CardRarity.Curse, TargetType.None)` (SporeMind.cs:14-17) == cost 1 / CURSE / CURSE / NONE. A REAL cost of 1, not the -1 sentinel the unplayable curses use, so the ascenders_bane cost finding does not apply and `_energy_cost = 1` is exact -- the same shape as card/enthralled.

OnPlay.rationale: SporeMind.cs declares no OnPlay, so playing it costs 1 energy, does nothing, and exhausts. A reachable no-op on both sides.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (spore_mind.py:27), which has no counterpart in SporeMind.cs
guards.rationale: Inert: the flag only steers `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference and the card deals no damage.
